requirements.verifier_assertion: test_update_skip_lines_are_exact_and_sorted asserts each announcement line matches SKIP_LINE_RE and equals GOLDEN_SKIP_LINES verbatim; every reported line has the exact prefix `Skipping ignored path: ` followed by a single space and the path with no trailing decoration.
test_update_skip_lines_are_exact_and_sorted also asserts paths use POSIX forward slashes (no backslash), are project-relative (no leading `/`), and are sorted alphabetically.

test_no_skip_report_when_ignored_paths_unchanged asserts `Skipping ignored path:` does NOT appear when the template didn't touch any ignored path this update. Only ignored paths that WOULD have been changed are announced.
must_include: ONLY paths that WOULD HAVE been changed
must NOT appear in the notice

requirements.verifier_assertion: Multiple tests (test_update_preserves_ignored_and_updates_managed, test_update_ignored_deleted_template_file_is_kept, test_update_ignored_new_template_file_is_not_created, test_update_ignored_user_deleted_file_is_not_recreated) collectively assert: matched paths are never created, modified, or deleted by update; on-disk user content wins; template additions and deletions of matched paths are ignored; user-deleted matched files are not resurrected.

test_update_creates_no_rej_files_in_git_repo (three-way-merge path) and rej_files(...) == [] assertions across other update tests (--reject fallback path) collectively require that matched paths never produce .rej files on either code path.

test_rules_come_from_new_template_version and test_project_only_cruftignore_has_no_effect assert the rule set governing an update is the incoming (target) template version's rendered .cruftignore, not the old version's, and not a stray project-side .cruftignore that wasn't shipped by the template.

test_cruftignore_is_never_self_ignored asserts that even with rules like `*` / `**` / `.*` the .cruftignore file itself is not self-excluded — it updates like any managed file. test_cruftignore_file_itself_is_updated confirms it flows through normal update.

test_update_composes_with_existing_skip_mechanism asserts .cruftignore stacks on top of the pre-existing `skip` list from `.cruft.json` / `pyproject.toml [tool.cruft] skip` — a path protected by EITHER mechanism is preserved. test_utils_generate_remove_paths_unchanged_regression additionally asserts the legacy `_remove_paths` helper still accepts a set of Path and removes them.

test_diff_excludes_ignored_paths, test_diff_exit_code_counts_only_managed_differences, and test_diff_after_successful_update_is_clean collectively assert diff output does not mention matched paths and --exit-code returns 0 when only matched paths differ.
must_include: must NOT appear in the diff output

requirements.verifier_assertion: test_diff_uses_checkout_versions_rules asserts the diff rule set is taken from --checkout (or the .cruft.json-recorded commit), not from the latest tip.

test_diff_output_is_clean_patch_text and test_diff_output_is_a_valid_patch assert the diff output stream contains no `Skipping` / advisory text and is applyable by `patch -p0`. The instruction requires the output remain a clean `git apply` / `patch` consumable patch.

test_update_with_skip_update_flag_still_bumps_state asserts --skip-update still advances .cruft.json commit. test_update_with_checkout_uses_that_versions_rules asserts --checkout re-targets the update. Instruction requires interactive y/n/s/v prompt, `-y`, --strict, subdirectory support, extra_context, three-way merge / --reject, and the `v` view excluding matched paths, all remain intact.

test_create_renders_everything and test_create_renders_everything_even_with_wildcard_rules assert cruft create emits every template file (including .cruftignore and every matched file) even when the rule set contains `*` / `**`.
must_include: every file that matches an ignore pattern

requirements.verifier_assertion: test_check_unaffected asserts `cruft check` still compares commit hashes and returns non-zero when template has new commits.
test_existing_offline_unit_tests_still_pass asserts pytest test_utils.py + test_exceptions.py (minus one skip-listed integration case) all pass unchanged after the feature is added.

test_pattern_semantics_end_to_end covers root-anchor (`/rooted.txt` matches root only), directory-only (`build/`), globstar (`src/**/gen_*.py`), and negation last-rule-wins (`*.log` then `!keep.log`).

Instruction requires user-facing documentation added to README.md; while test_outputs.py does not itself grep README, the engineering-requirements section of instruction.md makes it a task constraint. Tests use locally constructed temp git template repos and must not access the network.
